gallery.description: This small building stands next to the church of Biertan (Birthälm). There was the habit to close there for two weeks the couples that wanted to divorce. Inside there was only a bed and the necessary to eat. It actually worked because in 400 years only one couple eventually decided to break up

gallery.title: File:Biertan frescoes in catholic tower.jpg
gallery.description:
The fortified church is in the center of the village, on the hill, surrounded by two circular defense walls and several defense towers. One of them, the so-called Catholic Tower, was transformed into a chapel after the main church became Evangelical. This fresco, or what remains of it, is on the south wall of the tower’s ground level, and is XV-th century. This image is a enhanced picture of the paintings on the south wall and partially the vault above the ground chamber.
The church and its fortifications are since 1993 on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
